title: No-Bake Nut Cookies
ingredients: ["1 c. firmly packed brown sugar", "1/2 c. evaporated milk", "1/2 tsp. vanilla", "1/2 c. broken nuts (pecans)", "2 Tbsp. butter or margarine", "3 1/2 c. bite size shredded rice biscuits"]
directions: ["In a heavy 2-quart saucepan, mix brown sugar, nuts, evaporated milk and butter or margarine.", "Stir over medium heat until mixture bubbles all over top.", "Boil and stir 5 minutes more. Take off heat.", "Stir in vanilla and cereal; mix well.", "Using 2 teaspoons, drop and shape into 30 clusters on wax paper.", "Let stand until firm, about 30 minutes."]

title: Jewell Ball'S Chicken
ingredients: ["1 small jar chipped beef, cut up", "4 boned chicken breasts", "1 can cream of mushroom soup", "1 carton sour cream"]
directions: ["Place chipped beef on bottom of baking dish.", "Place chicken on top of beef.", "Mix soup and cream together; pour over chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours."]

title: Creamy Corn
ingredients: ["2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen corn", "1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cubed", "1/3 c. butter, cubed", "1/2 tsp. garlic powder", "1/2 tsp. salt", "1/4 tsp. pepper"]
directions: ["In a slow cooker, combine all ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until heated through and cheese is melted. Stir well before serving. Yields 6 servings."]

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: ["1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips", "2 c. broccoli florets", "1 red bell pepper, sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 Tbsp. fresh ginger, grated", "3 Tbsp. soy sauce", "1 Tbsp. cornstarch", "1 Tbsp. vegetable oil", "2 c. cooked brown rice"]
directions: ["Heat oil in a wok. Stir-fry chicken until done.", "Add broccoli, pepper, garlic and ginger; cook 3 minutes.", "Mix soy sauce and cornstarch with 1/4 cup water; add and cook until thick.", "Serve over rice. Serves 4."]

title: Black Bean Quinoa Salad
ingredients: ["1 c. quinoa, rinsed", "2 c. water", "1 (15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained", "1 c. frozen corn, thawed", "1 red bell pepper, diced", "1/4 c. chopped fresh cilantro", "3 Tbsp. olive oil", "juice of 2 limes", "1 tsp. cumin", "salt to taste"]
directions: ["Cook quinoa in water 15 minutes; cool.", "Toss with beans, corn, pepper and cilantro.", "Whisk oil, lime juice and cumin; pour over salad. Makes 4 servings."]

title: Lentil Soup
ingredients: ["1 Tbsp. olive oil", "1 onion, chopped", "2 carrots, diced", "2 stalks celery, diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 c. dry lentils, rinsed", "1 (14.5 oz.) can diced tomatoes", "6 c. vegetable broth", "1 tsp. cumin", "2 c. fresh spinach"]
directions: ["Heat oil; cook onion, carrot and celery 5 minutes.", "Add garlic, lentils, tomatoes, broth and cumin; simmer 30 minutes.", "Stir in spinach until wilted. Serves 6."]

title: Baked Salmon
ingredients: ["4 salmon fillets", "2 Tbsp. olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 lemon, sliced", "1 tsp. dried dill", "salt and pepper to taste"]
directions: ["Heat oven to 400\u00b0.", "Place salmon on a baking sheet; brush with oil and garlic.", "Top with lemon and dill. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Serves 4."]

title: Beef Tacos
ingredients: ["1 lb. ground beef", "1 envelope taco seasoning", "3/4 c. water", "8 taco shells", "1 c. shredded Cheddar cheese", "2 c. shredded lettuce", "1 tomato, diced", "1/2 c. sour cream", "1/2 c. salsa"]
directions: ["Brown beef; drain.", "Add seasoning and water; simmer 10 minutes.", "Fill shells with beef and toppings. Serves 4."]

title: Peanut Butter Noodles
ingredients: ["8 oz. spaghetti", "1/4 c. peanut butter", "3 Tbsp. soy sauce", "1 Tbsp. honey", "1 Tbsp. sesame oil", "2 green onions, sliced", "1 Tbsp. sesame seeds"]
directions: ["Cook pasta; drain.", "Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil.", "Toss with pasta; top with onions and seeds. Serves 4."]

title: Greek Chicken Salad
ingredients: ["2 c. cooked chicken, cubed", "1 cucumber, diced", "1 c. cherry tomatoes, halved", "1/2 c. kalamata olives", "1/2 c. crumbled feta cheese", "1/4 c. red onion, sliced", "3 Tbsp. olive oil", "2 Tbsp. red wine vinegar", "1 tsp. dried oregano"]
directions: ["Combine chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, feta and onion.", "Whisk oil, vinegar and oregano; toss. Serves 4."]

title: Veggie Omelet
ingredients: ["3 eggs", "1/4 c. milk", "1/4 c. chopped green pepper", "1/4 c. chopped onion", "1/4 c. sliced mushrooms", "1 Tbsp. butter", "1/4 c. shredded Cheddar cheese"]
directions: ["Beat eggs and milk.", "Saute vegetables in butter; add eggs.", "Cook until set; sprinkle cheese and fold. Serves 1."]

title: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: ["1 lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined", "8 oz. linguine", "4 Tbsp. butter", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "1/2 c. dry white wine", "2 Tbsp. lemon juice", "1/4 c. chopped parsley", "1/4 tsp. red pepper flakes"]
directions: ["Cook linguine.", "Melt butter; cook garlic 1 minute. Add shrimp; cook 2 minutes per side.", "Add wine and lemon juice; simmer 2 minutes. Toss with pasta and parsley. Serves 4."]

title: Oven Fries
ingredients: ["4 russet potatoes, cut into wedges", "2 Tbsp. olive oil", "1 tsp. paprika", "1/2 tsp. garlic powder", "1/2 tsp. salt"]
directions: ["Toss potatoes with oil and seasonings.", "Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 minutes, turning once. Serves 4."]

title: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: ["2 c. broccoli florets", "2 carrots, sliced", "1 zucchini, sliced", "1 red onion, cut in wedges", "2 Tbsp. olive oil", "1 tsp. dried thyme", "1/2 tsp. salt"]
directions: ["Toss vegetables with oil, thyme and salt.", "Roast at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 4."]

title: Turkey Chili
ingredients: ["1 lb. ground turkey", "1 onion, chopped", "1 green pepper, chopped", "2 cloves garlic", "2 (15 oz.) cans kidney beans, drained", "1 (28 oz.) can crushed tomatoes", "2 Tbsp. chili powder", "1 tsp. cumin", "1 c. chicken broth"]
directions: ["Brown turkey with onion, pepper and garlic.", "Add remaining ingredients; simmer 45 minutes. Serves 6."]

title: Mom's Meat Loaf
ingredients: ["2 lb. hamburger", "1 c. cracker crumbs", "2 eggs", "1 c. milk", "1 onion, chopped", "1/2 c. ketchup", "1 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce", "1 tsp. salt"]
directions: ["Mix all but ketchup. Shape into loaf.", "Top with ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8."]

title: Banana Oat Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 banana", "1/2 c. rolled oats", "1 c. unsweetened almond milk", "1 Tbsp. almond butter", "1/2 tsp. cinnamon"]
directions: ["Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serves 1."]

title: Chickpea Curry
ingredients: ["1 Tbsp. coconut oil", "1 onion, diced", "3 cloves garlic", "1 Tbsp. curry powder", "2 (15 oz.) cans chickpeas, drained", "1 (14 oz.) can coconut milk", "1 (14.5 oz.) can diced tomatoes", "2 c. baby spinach", "2 c. cooked rice"]
directions: ["Heat oil; cook onion and garlic.", "Add curry powder, chickpeas, coconut milk and tomatoes; simmer 20 minutes.", "Stir in spinach. Serve over rice. Serves 4."]

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
ingredients: ["4 zucchini, spiralized", "1/2 c. basil pesto", "1 c. cherry tomatoes, halved", "2 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese"]
directions: ["Saute zucchini 2 minutes.", "Toss with pesto and tomatoes; top with Parmesan. Serves 2."]

title: Grandma's Mystery Casserole
ingredients: ["1 lb. hamburger", "1 pkg. Tater Tots", "1 can Cheddar cheese soup", "1 jar Gramma's secret sauce"]
directions: ["Layer and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes."]

title: Egg Fried Rice
ingredients: ["3 c. cooked rice", "2 eggs, beaten", "1 c. frozen peas and carrots", "3 green onions, sliced", "2 Tbsp. soy sauce", "1 Tbsp. sesame oil"]
directions: ["Scramble eggs in oil; remove.", "Fry rice and vegetables; add soy sauce and eggs. Serves 4."]

title: Steak and Potatoes
ingredients: ["2 (8 oz.) sirloin steaks", "4 red potatoes, quartered", "2 Tbsp. butter", "2 Tbsp. olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp. rosemary"]
directions: ["Roast potatoes with oil and rosemary at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.", "Sear steaks in butter and garlic 4 minutes per side. Serves 2."]

title: Tofu Veggie Bowl
ingredients: ["1 (14 oz.) pkg. extra firm tofu, cubed", "1 Tbsp. olive oil", "2 c. broccoli florets", "1 c. shredded carrots", "1 c. cooked quinoa", "2 Tbsp. tamari", "1 tsp. ginger"]
directions: ["Crisp tofu in oil.", "Add vegetables; cook 5 minutes.", "Serve over quinoa with tamari. Serves 2."]

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
ingredients: ["1 lb. spaghetti", "1/2 c. butter", "6 cloves garlic, minced", "1/2 c. Parmesan", "1/4 c. chopped parsley"]
directions: ["Cook pasta.", "Melt butter with garlic; toss with pasta, Parmesan and parsley. Serves 6."]
